column3: Close to the Hebrew; “you will not waver” is rendered “you shall not be moved.”
Close to the Hebrew; “plow unplowed ground” is rendered “Break up your fallow ground.”
Close to the Hebrew; “call out, fill” (cry aloud) is rendered “Cry, ‘Gather together.’”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the throat” (nephesh) is rendered “to the heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “scorching wind” is rendered “A dry wind,” and NKJV supplies “blows.”
Close to the Hebrew; “too full for these” is rendered “too strong for these.”
Close to the Hebrew; נֹצְרִים (“watchers,” notzrim) is rendered “watchers.”
NKJV follows the Qere “I am pained” and renders “my inward parts” as “O my soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fools” is rendered “silly children.”
Close to the Hebrew; “formlessness and emptiness” (tohu wa-bohu) is rendered “without form, and void,” as in Gen 1:2.
Close to the Hebrew; “the garden-land” (Carmel) is rendered “the fruitful land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every city” is rendered “The whole city.”
Close to the Hebrew; “tear open your eyes with paint” is rendered “enlarge your eyes with paint.”
